name: marketing-carts
title: Carts
description: Shopping cart UI components for eCommerce checkout flows, including a popup mini-cart overlay, a popup with quantity and coupon actions, and a full-page cart layout.
useWhen: Showing a mini-cart preview that slides in when a user adds an item, without leaving the current page.
Building a full cart page where users review items, adjust quantities, apply coupon codes, and proceed to checkout.
Providing a cart summary in a side panel during a multi-step checkout flow.
avoidWhen: The store has only digital single-purchase products — a direct checkout page is simpler than a cart flow.
Quantity editing is not supported — use a simpler order summary instead.
The cart is shown inside a modal on mobile — a full-page cart layout works better on narrow viewports.
responsiveBehavior: Popup cart overlays appear as a fixed side drawer on desktop and a full-screen sheet on mobile. Full-page carts restack their item list and order summary to a single column on mobile.
accessibility: Popup cart panels should use role='dialog' with aria-label='Shopping cart' and trap focus while open.
Quantity increment/decrement buttons must have aria-label='Increase quantity' / 'Decrease quantity'.
Product images in cart must have alt text describing the product.

variants.title: Popup
variants.description: Minimal popup mini-cart showing cart items with image, name, price, and a checkout CTA — slides in from the right without leaving the page.
accessibility: Panel uses role='dialog'; focus is trapped while open; Escape key closes the panel.

variants.title: Popup (Dark)
variants.description: Minimal popup mini-cart adapted for dark eCommerce surfaces with dark panel background.
accessibility: Product name, price, and close button must meet WCAG AA contrast on the dark cart panel background.

variants.title: Popup with actions
variants.description: Popup mini-cart with quantity adjustment controls and a remove-item action per line item — for carts where users commonly edit before checking out.
accessibility: Quantity inputs must have aria-label; remove buttons must identify which product they remove via aria-label.

variants.title: Popup with actions (Dark)
variants.description: Action-equipped popup mini-cart adapted for dark eCommerce surfaces.
accessibility: Action button icons and input fields must meet contrast requirements on dark cart panel backgrounds.

variants.title: Page
variants.description: Full-page cart layout with a line-item list on the left and an order summary with coupon code field and checkout CTA on the right.
accessibility: Form fields for coupon code must have visible labels; order total must be announced when the page updates after quantity changes.

variants.title: Page (Dark)
variants.description: Full-page cart layout adapted for dark eCommerce surfaces with dark background cart items and order summary.
accessibility: All form fields, product details, and order summary text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark page backgrounds.
